consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking 'does the player possess the required item count?' to mark the fetch mission complete
scope: items reachable in the player's crafting_inventory() (carried plus nearby-reachable), not only on-person carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — computes a yes/no by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges(type->item_id, item_count) and returns it as the completion verdict
divergence: the required part sits in an open reachable container adjacent to the player but is not worn/wielded/in inventory: crafting_inventory() and thus is_complete return true, while a narrower on-person possession check (u_has_items / has_amount over only carried items) returns false
